_comment: HOST4 (spec/rules/host.md): above-floor APIs. Each entry names the API, its fallback, the user-visible degradation, and the sites allowed to use it bare. A site is a path string (legacy, still valid) or { path, reason }. New sites must be { path, reason } — a path-only object is the parking-lot shape. Feature-detected uses do not need a site. An entry without fallback or degradation is a lint error. Remove a site in the same PR that adds a feature test. The no-above-floor-api lint owns this file.

apis.fallback: ContentEditableBackend (composition-event path). Forced for expanded surfaces and table cells even when EditContext exists.
apis.degradation: IME uses the composition-event path (Safari late mutation, GBoard 50ms heuristic) instead of EditContext textupdate; composition underline and IME window bounds follow the native contenteditable caret rather than textformatupdate/characterboundsupdate. Typing, paste, and undo still work.

apis.fallback: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value)); a failed clone leaves the last full preview snapshot.
apis.degradation: Non-JSON values drop; a failed clone leaves the last full preview snapshot instead of a live patch replay.

apis.fallback: window resize and scroll listeners only; no element-box observer.
apis.degradation: Overlays do not remeasure when the host element resizes without a window resize or scroll.

apis.fallback: replaceElementChildren: while (firstChild) remove, then append. Clearing then appending is equivalent.
apis.degradation: Inactive inline/cell content and drag-preview roots still empty — no user-visible degradation. Product sites go through replaceElementChildren, which feature-detects replaceChildren and otherwise clears then appends.
None. At the HOST3 floor (Chromium 93 / Firefox 92 / Safari 15.4); listed as trivially replaceable. Product sites use Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call.
None. At the HOST3 floor; last element still used. Product sites use index arithmetic (array[array.length - 1] for at(-1)).

apis.fallback: Solid first in the same rule (#7c3aed / #2563eb), then color-mix in the same property.
apis.degradation: Without color-mix the user sees the solid first color, not a missing highlight.

apis.fallback: Code-point walks for graphemes; whitespace runs for words (packages/core/src/editor/textSegmentation.ts). Wave L (LOC4) owns this entry.
apis.degradation: Word ops degrade to whitespace runs; character ops degrade to code points, never to UTF-16 code units.

sites.reason: Node-only test (node:test / node:assert / node:fs); never shipped to a browser, so the HOST3/HOST4 browser API floor does not apply
